critical.label: zip
critical.description: zip is a zip library for Rust that supports reading and writing simple ZIP files. Through 9.0.4, ZipArchive treats Central Directory File Header filenames as authoritative while ZipStreamReader extracts using Local File Header filenames without reconciling the duplicate metadata in src/read/stream.rs. A crafted archive can therefore appear benign to a component that inspects the central directory but cause a streaming extractor to write a different attacker-selected path and content, potentially overwriting files used by a downstream service. This issue is fixed in version 9.0.5.

international.summary_ko: 글로벌 컨택센터 솔루션 기업 제네시스가 외부 비인가 접근을 확인하고 10월 19일 공지함. 공격자가 CRM과 LMS에 접근해 일부 정보를 열람·반출함. 고객사 연계 영향 확인 필요.
